compliance_decision:
Compliance Answer: Aggregated cash transactions should be listed individually and not summarised as a single combined transaction on the CTRA, especially when they exceed prescribed thresholds or involve repetitions of similar types of transactions with the same client.
Relevant Regulatory Basis: Source 1 - Guidance Note (2019-03) Drafted by CTRs Committee for Anti-Money Laundering and Combating Terrorism Financing, Chunk 396 of guidance document on aggregated cash transactions.
Explanation: The regulatory context specifies that a series of smaller amounts should be individually listed if they form an aggregated transaction exceeding the threshold or involve repetition with respect to client and business relationship as per CTRs Committee guidelines, thus requiring individual listing for compliance purposes on CTRA.
Human Review Required: Yes
